Q: Extract selected data from multiple lines of text A:

You may use this awk script:

awk -F'"|: ' '{sub(/\r$/, "")} 
$1 == "Content-Length" {clen = $2}
/filename=/ {fn = $3}
END {print clen ", " fn}' file

77829730, filename.mp3

Where input file is:

cat file

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: CacheHTTPd v1.0
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 19:21:11 +0000
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
Content-Length: 77829730
Etag: "f88a7c370819f133ddf3bc4fbb7087f611cce890"
Expires: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 01:21:06 +0000
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="filename.mp3"
Accept-Ranges: bytes
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
Connection: close

Note that by using -F'"|: ' we are splitting input line using delimiters : or ".

Q: How to check if form is valid with Valibot? A:

You just need to use safeParse instead of parse to check if the form is valid like this:

v.safeParse(schema, state).success

The result of safeParse includes the issues as well.

References:

  • https://github.com/nuxt/ui/issues/966#issuecomment-1811566258
  • https://valibot.dev/api/safeParse/
  • https://valibot.dev/api/SafeParseResult/

Q: Spring Boot Prometheus Push Gateway: Metrics missing label A:

This is expected...

grouping-key is only used by the Pushgateway to identify the push (same bucket as job/instance), Micrometer does not turn those values into metric labels.

So even if the env var is set, you won’t see namespace on the time series... If you actually want it as a label, add it as a Micrometer tag (management.metrics.tags.namespace=... or a registry customizer).

A bit confusing naming, but that’s how it works.

Q: Trying to resolve value error: invalid mode in Python script A:

I think the problem is related to second parameter (Check the documentation https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#open)

open(file, mode='')

You need a param with the mode to work with a file

open("Users\steve\homework\PyBank\PyBank_data.csv", mode='r')

or something like that

Q: ssh "port 22: no route to host" error in bash script A:

There might be a firewall service running on remote server and hence it is blocking the access.

$ sudo su
# apt install firewalld (If not installed)
# firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=22/tcp

Or


$ apt install firewalld (If not installed)
$ sudo ufw allow 22/tcp
